decisions.reason: As a web-map add-on with multiple early releases and strong fit to the firm's existing platform business, it remains a low-cost option worth keeping while market demand becomes clearer.

Although it appears less prominently and may face overlap with other search-related modules, it is still a relatively cheap adjacent option in the firm's core web-GIS offer and so is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
Its homepage visibility and clear mobile usability benefit suggest promising but still unresolved value, making continued market presence the sensible option.

A GIS solution platform is strategically important and close to the firm's enterprise-integration direction, so despite potentially higher carrying costs the firm is likely to keep it to preserve upside under uncertainty.
Mobile field data capture fits well with public-sector and infrastructure use cases and, with dedicated presentation on the website, looks like an option the firm would continue to hold.
This search extension is close to the established web-map business and likely inexpensive to maintain, so despite some portfolio crowding the firm would probably keep it for another year.
